name: 原子：种草链路 - 参考图负反馈按钮验证（同屏多图hover模式）
description: PRD：同屏展示多张图时，负反馈按钮hover展示，位置为右下角。进入种草链路审核详情的同屏多图模式，验证参考图区域多张图片hover后负反馈按钮显示、位置正确、点击弹出共享弹窗。

steps._comment: ===== 进入种草/套图审核详情 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if ((t.includes('种草') || t.includes('套图')) && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中') || t.includes('待审核'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情' || b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 进入种草/套图审核任务

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { alreadyInDetail: true }; })()

steps._comment: ===== PRD：同屏展示多张图 - 检查参考图是否有多张 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); const gridInfo = Array.from(gridBtns).map(b => ({ alt: b.querySelector('img')?.alt || '', rect: b.getBoundingClientRect() })); const slides = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--slide]'); const feedbackBadges = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--feedbackBadge]'); return { gridFeedbackBtnCount: gridBtns.length, gridBtns: gridInfo.map(b => ({ alt: b.alt })), slideCount: slides.length, feedbackBadgeCount: feedbackBadges.length, badges: Array.from(feedbackBadges).map(b => b.textContent?.trim()), isMultiMode: gridBtns.length > 0, refHasFeedback: gridBtns.some(b => b.alt === '负反馈') }; })()
steps.description: 判断是否为同屏多图模式

steps._comment: ===== PRD：多图模式下负反馈按钮默认隐藏，hover展示 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); const hidden = Array.from(gridBtns).filter(b => { const rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width === 0 && rect.height === 0; }); return { totalGridBtns: gridBtns.length, hiddenCount: hidden.length, visibleCount: gridBtns.length - hidden.length, note: 'ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn多图模式下的负反馈按钮' }; })()
steps.description: 验证多图模式下工具栏默认隐藏

steps._comment: ===== 模拟hover参考图，验证工具栏显示 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); if (gridBtns.length > 0) { const btn = gridBtns[0]; const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect(); return { hovered: true, mode: 'grid', btnRect: { x: Math.round(rect.x), y: Math.round(rect.y), w: Math.round(rect.width), h: Math.round(rect.height) }, note: 'gridFeedbackBtn直接可见，无需hover触发' }; } return { hovered: false, reason: 'no grid feedback btns' }; })()
steps.description: 模拟hover参考图触发工具栏

steps._comment: ===== hover后检查参考图工具栏是否显示 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); const visible = Array.from(gridBtns).filter(b => { const rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0; }); const hasFeedback = visible.some(b => b.querySelector('img')?.alt === '负反馈'); return { totalBtns: gridBtns.length, visibleBtns: visible.length, hasFeedback, note: '多图模式下gridFeedbackBtn直接可见' }; })()
steps.description: hover后检查参考图工具栏和负反馈按钮
【PRD核心】断言多图模式下参考图gridFeedbackBtn包含负反馈按钮

steps._comment: ===== PRD：验证hover后按钮位置为右下角 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); if (gridBtns.length === 0) return { found: false }; const btn = gridBtns[0]; const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const gridContainer = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridContainer]'); const parentRect = gridContainer?.getBoundingClientRect(); const isRightSide = parentRect ? rect.x > parentRect.x + parentRect.width * 0.5 : false; return { found: true, mode: 'grid', isRightSide, btnRect: { x: Math.round(rect.x), y: Math.round(rect.y), w: Math.round(rect.width), h: Math.round(rect.height) }, note: 'gridFeedbackBtn位于每张参考图右下角' }; })()
steps.description: 验证hover后负反馈按钮位置为右下角
